title: Fools Will Resign!!
reviewNotes: All 28 states and captions reviewed. This is a crowded middlegame mating combination with both sides retaining queens, rooks, multiple minor pieces and many pawns. Qf4+, the knight offer, rook captures and final bishop mate are a king-hunt sequence without a worked endgame phase. Retained in the searchable channel archive outside the endgame-study scope.
